assays.assay_description: Mice injected i.p. with DOI or 25CN-NBOH (with or without M100907 / RS102221 pretreatment, or with 25CN-NBOH pretreatment before DOI), placed in an observation cage with fresh bedding; 10 min after injection, an overhead camera recorded behavior for 10 min and head twitches were manually scored by a blind observer.

application_type.evidence: Doses were then calculated and prepared for intraperitoneal (ip) injection

setup_habituation.evidence: individual animals were removed from the home cage, injected... and placed into an observation cage

setup_restrain.evidence: placed into an observation cage containing fresh bedding

food_restriction.evidence: Neither food nor water was available during the experiments.

water_restriction.evidence: Neither food nor water was available during the experiments.

time_to_assay.evidence: Ten minutes following this injection, an overhead camera was activated and behavior was recorded for 10 min.

sample_size.evidence: animals allocated for head twitch experiments (n=5 per group)

outcomes.summary: DOI produced a characteristic biphasic dose-dependent increase in head twitches (max ~20 twitches/10 min at 1.0 mg/kg). 25CN-NBOH elicited fewer twitches (max ~10 at 1.0 mg/kg) with a shallow descending limb; effect was blocked by M100907 (5-HT2A antagonist) but not by RS102221 (5-HT2C antagonist). 25CN-NBOH pretreatment dose-dependently attenuated DOI-elicited head twitches.
outcomes.evidence: 25CN-NBOH induced a head twitch response in the mouse that was lower in magnitude than that of DOI, blocked by M100907, but not altered by RS102221. DOI-elicited head twitch was dose-dependently attenuated by 25CN-NBOH pretreatment.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: mean head twitches recorded over a 10-min observation period

assays.assay_description: Two-lever, food-reinforced operant drug discrimination (FR5) in MED Associates chambers. Mice trained to discriminate 0.3 mg/kg DOI from saline, or 0.1 mg/kg M100907 from saline; substitution tested with cumulative doses of DOI, 25CN-NBOH (±M100907 pretreatment), ketanserin. 30-min sessions; % drug-appropriate lever responses and response rate measured.

application_type.evidence: Injections were administered ip 10 min before extension of the response levers

setup_restrain.evidence: Studies were conducted in operant-conditioning chambers for mice; animals were freely moving

food_restriction.evidence: mice assigned to drug discrimination studies (n=6 per group) were food-restricted to maintain weights at 30±2 g throughout testing

water_restriction.evidence: reinforced by 2 s of access to a palatable liquid reinforcer (approximately 0.02 ml evaporated milk diluted 1:1 with tap water)

time_to_assay.evidence: Injections were administered ip 10 min before extension of the response levers

sample_size.evidence: mice assigned to drug discrimination studies (n=6 per group)

outcomes.summary: Mice reliably discriminated 0.3 mg/kg DOI and 0.1 mg/kg M100907 from saline. DOI produced full dose-dependent substitution; 25CN-NBOH only partially substituted (~55% max) for DOI and these effects were attenuated by M100907. 25CN-NBOH did not substitute for M100907 at any dose, whereas ketanserin fully substituted. High doses of 25CN-NBOH suppressed response rates.
outcomes.statistics: DOI training vs saline q=9.205, p<0.05; cumulative DOI 0.1, 0.3 mg/kg vs saline q=7.591, 9.297, df=12, p<0.05; 25CN-NBOH 10, 30 mg/kg vs saline q=5.233, 5.332, df=12, p<0.05; M100907 training vs saline q=10.506, df=16, p<0.05; ketanserin 0.1, 0.3, 1.0 mg/kg vs saline q=6.484, 8.173, 10.105, df=16, p<0.05; 25CN-NBOH 0.1–30 mg/kg vs M100907 TD q=9.438, 9.082, 7.882, 8.485, 8.205, 8.107, p<0.05
outcomes.evidence: 25CN-NBOH produced an intermediate degree of generalization (55%) for the DOI training dose, and these interoceptive effects were attenuated by M100907. Finally, 25CN-NBOH did not generalize to M100907 at any dose, but ketanserin fully substituted in these animals.

B1_num_measures.evidence: Percent drug-appropriate responding... Response rate was calculated for each session

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: responding aggregated per component, no within-session time-course analysis

B4_ethological.evidence: lever pressing is not an ethological behaviour

B5_social.evidence: individually enclosed in lightproof sound-attenuating cubicles

B6_cognitive.evidence: Mice were trained... to discriminate either 0.3 mg/kg DOI or 0.1 mg/kg M100907 from saline vehicle

B7_automated_classification.evidence: MED Associates operant chambers (beam/lever switch detection, not behavioural classification)

E6_spatial.evidence: single operant chamber with two levers

E7_social_context.evidence: individually enclosed in larger lightproof Malaguard sound-attenuating cubicles

E8_food_water.evidence: reinforced by 2 s of access to a palatable liquid reinforcer (evaporated milk diluted 1:1 with tap water)

D1_continuity.evidence: Mice were trained 5 days per week... tests were conducted once or twice per week

D2_session_duration.evidence: mice were trained in 30-min sessions 5 days per week

D3_recording_days.evidence: Mice were trained 5 days per week... Training was complete when mice performed stably over five consecutive sessions under the terminal FR5 schedule... tests were conducted once or twice per week

D4_baseline.evidence: Approximately half of the test sessions were conducted the day after saline training sessions... saline control sessions

D5_followup.evidence: no post-acute follow-up >=24h after a single drug administration scheme

judge_notes: Merged glm's two separate drug-discrimination assays (DOI-trained and M100907-trained) into a single 'Drug Discrimination (operant)' entry, since the rubric defines an assay by paradigm/apparatus/measures, and the only difference is the training drug — a manipulation, not a different paradigm.
B1 for HTR scored 0 (1 measure: head-twitch count); glm's score of 1 with value '1' was inconsistent.
D3 for drug discrimination scored 3 (15+) — training takes many weeks of daily sessions plus weekly tests; gptoss underestimated as 2-7.
D4 baseline for drug discrimination scored 1: saline training/control sessions are recorded and reported as baseline reference for substitution analysis.
DOI is listed in dosing because it is a classical 5-HT2A psychedelic administered to rodents alongside 25CN-NBOH.
